text:
jane_support: FYI ZenChart reports sudden p99 jump from ~120ms -> ~620ms starting 03:14 UTC. Customer trace shows an unexpected hop to ap-south-1 egress. Any routing changes? https://redwood/logs/zc-98765 :worried:

maria_sre: @jane_support can you paste the raw hop list + any client headers? wondering if region override is present

jane_support: pasted from their trace:
```
TraceID: zc-98765
client_region: eu-west-1
request_path: frontend -> proxy-eu -> gateway-ap-south -> inference-eu
latencies_ms: 110, 15, 480, 20
egress_ip: 52.59.12.4 (ap-south-1)
headers: x-redwood-region: eu-west-1
```

kyle_network: that gateway-ap-south hop is surprising. No network deploys in last 24h on that edge. I'll run path probes and bgp checks now :eyes:

alex_platform: fwiw we rolled the new smart-routing canary yesterday that can prefer lower-cost egress when under load. if fallback mapping is wrong for some accounts it could force an ap-south path. @maria_sre can you check the account routing policy for ZenChart (acct 3342)?

maria_sre: digging into routing-service: account 3342 policy shows preferred: eu-west-1 but fallback list contains ap-south-1 as a lower-cost fallback. weirdly the region tag parser missed the leading region token for some entries — looks like a parsing bug that swaps fallback order for tags without the dash.

jane_support: :relieved: nice catch. Customer asked for a quick mitigation, can we force egress back to eu for them?

kyle_network: will apply a temporary egress lock to force eu nat. running: `./egress-lock --account 3342 --region eu-west-1 --ttl 30m`

ops-bot: Action queued: egress-lock requested by kyle_network for account 3342

ops-bot: Action started: egress-lock for account 3342 (run id: 2026-03-17-01)

maria_sre: deploying hotfix to routing-service parser. will canary at 2% then promote. PR: https://git/repo/2987 — rolling now

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: routing-service@v2.14.1-canary (2%)

alex_platform: can we validate by replaying the trace or synthetic requests? I can run sim-client against account 3342 to repro path before/after lock

jane_support: asked customer to run 5 requests with curl and they just replied: "p99 ~130ms now". They sent one of the new traces which shows no ap-south hop.

kyle_network: :thumbsup: egress-lock applied, path probes show egress to eu nat 3 for the past 5 mins

maria_sre: hotfix canary looks good; promoting. will follow up with postmortem tomorrow.

ops-bot: Action complete: egress-lock finished (run id: 2026-03-17-01)

jane_support: Closing for now. Customer back to expected latency. Will reopen if it recurs.

kyle_network: tagging incident for follow-up and a short postmortem. If anyone has metrics or traces to add, drop them on the thread.

deploy-bot: Deploy complete: routing-service@v2.14.1 (100%)

maria_sre: Note for postmortem: root cause likely parser edge-case in routing-service that flipped fallback order for some region tag formats. Impact: accounts with that tag (including ZenChart) briefly routed to ap-south fallback causing cross-region p99 spike.

jane_support: thanks all :heart:
